data: Which of the product search benchmarks shows the highest value of LSE when the entity space dimensionality is 128?

The question asks which benchmark shows the highest value of LSE when the entity space dimensionality is 128. From the caption, we know that the comparison is made across four product search benchmarks: Home & Kitchen, Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry, Pet Supplies, and Sports & Outdoors. The figure provides a comparison of LSE with other baselines at different entity space dimensionality values.

Looking at the graphs:

- For Home & Kitchen (a), the LSE line peaks around 0.25 at an entity space dimensionality of 128.
- For Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry (b), the LSE line peaks around 0.12 at an entity space dimensionality of 128.
- For Pet Supplies (c), the LSE line peaks around 0.20 at an entity space dimensionality of 128.
- For Sports & Outdoors (d), the LSE line peaks around 0.15 at an entity space dimensionality of 128.

Comparing these peak values, Home & Kitchen has the highest value of LSE at 128 entity space dimensionality.

Thus, the benchmark showing the highest value of LSE at 128 entity space dimensionality is Home & Kitchen.
